The analysis does not mention OPS-77's due date (2026-09-10), that it is overdue, the last update date (2026-09-11), that Northwind has not replied, or that the partner manager was already asked to escalate.
The analysis does not mention the 3.2.0 release date (2026-09-24), the sprint end date (2026-09-22), or that Ravi needs about two days for end-to-end testing after the certificates arrive.
The analysis does not assess the risk to the 3.2.0 release, does not note the tight timeline, and does not observe that Northwind has not committed to a delivery date.
The analysis does not mention that the code is complete, merged, or behind the MTLS_PARTNER feature flag (off by default).
